assessments.name: Final exam
assessments.description:
The final exam will test your understanding of and ability to apply key concepts from the unit. The exam will cover materials from assigned
readings, lectures, and tutorials. The final exam will be held during the exam period. It is a closed-book exam.

assessments.name: Participation
assessments.description:
Students are expected to attend class, contribute to discussions and teamwork, and demonstrate engagement and understanding in different
learning activities such as business case analyses, experiential exercises,presentations, and debates.

assessments.name: Mid term exam
assessments.description: The mid-term exam will test your understanding of and ability to apply key concepts from the unit. It is a closed-book exam that covers all the lecturers and tutorials up to the teaching session before the exam.

assessments.name: News Flash Presentation
assessments.description:
Teams have to choose a recent (within that last 6 months) event/news in the business world that demonstrates the practical relevance of one
concept discussed in the lectures or assigned readings. Teams are then required to prepare a presentation (20 min).
